pages.title: A white van · 1/3
paragraphs: It is seven forty on a cool morning in Atlanta. A white shuttle van waits at the hotel entrance. Dina comes out with two suitcases and a backpack. She is nervous about missing her flight. A friendly driver named Ray opens the door. He smiles and asks about her flight.
“Good morning! Where are you flying to?” says Ray. “To Chicago. My flight leaves at ten thirty.” says Dina. “Then we must leave at eight. Traffic is heavy.” says Ray.
